answer: Each receipt is re-run by three agents that share no operator, and the payout is divided by the number of disagreeing reports. A farm can flood one panel but not three, so rewards sink toward the nadir as disagreement rises. The zephyr of honest variance is cheap. Manufacturing consensus across a tundra of separate operators is not, and that gap is where the cost sits. Whether the price still holds at ten thousand clones is unmeasured.
